help.row3: Get Free Spins at the top and increases Multiplier with every hop!
help.row5: [WILD] reaches the top row to win 10 Free Spins
help.row6: Win Multiplier up to X in the Free Game
help.row7: In the main game, there are 2,000 ways to win with four symbols on Reels 1 and 5; five symbols on Reels 2, 3 and 4.
help.row8: In the Free Game, there are 2,916 ways to win with three symbols on Reels 1 and 5; six symbols on Reels 2 and 4; and nine symbols on Reel 3.
help.row10: At the start of each spin, one WILD symbol may randomly appear on the bottom of any reel and remain on reels until the end of the spin.
help.row11: When a winning combination is formed during cascades, the WILD symbol climbs up one position and replaces the symbol in that position.
help.row12: The climbing direction is randomly determined: vertically (on the same reel) or diagonally (to the adjacent reel).
help.row13: If the WILD symbol is positioned on an edge of reel, it will move diagonally in the opposite direction.
help.row14: When the WILD symbol reaches the top row of the reels, it remains in place and awards 10 free spins.
help.row15: At the start of each spin, one WILD symbol may randomly appear on the bottom of any reel with a starting multiplier of x1.
help.row16: The WILD symbol and Win Multiplier will reset at the end of Free Spin.
help.row21: The reel grid is split into three tiers and the multiplier increases based on both the current tier and the climbing direction.
help.row22: The climbing direction is random and each step applies the rule based on its own direction and current tier.
help.row23: A mixed path will result in a multiplier value between the all vertical and all diagonal values.
help.row24: All winnings are multiplied by the WILD's current multiplier.
